C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX.Name: Export consent boundaries verified end to end: the docx/html embed-consent and PlantUML-consent gates and the fenced diff baseline get artifact-level e2e pins through the real renderer, holding the C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES delivery honestly
C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES-DOCX.Summary: The wave-5 audit brief names three docx/html export-boundary leaks — out-of-directory image embedding without consent (brief F-005/F-008), PlantUML fences rendering through plantuml.com in the html export without consent (F-006), and the diff .before sidecar read bypassing the #296 fs funnel — and asks for a consent spec. Code walk on this base (638c0a7c, worktree green-w5b) verifies all three are ALREADY CLOSED: archived applied C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES delivered the embed scope gate (exportImages.js isInDocumentScope + two-phase consent pass), the render-time PlantUML consent gate (exportHtml.js plantumlRemoteConsent, declined placeholder), and the fenced sidecar read (m031_diff.rs SecurityCtx + check_path), and archived applied C-EXPORT-DOCUMENT-PIN wrapped both consent cards in export identity pinning; unit-level pins, ten-locale card copy and graph/verification deltas all landed. What genuinely remains open is the layer above the unit pins: the embed-consent card is mounted by NO e2e test, the PlantUML card's only e2e mount is tests/e2e/export-document-pin.spec.ts :64-71 — answered there purely inside the pin-refusal and consented-identity scenarios, never to observe the consent form — and no saved-artifact double ever asserts the consent form (declined src kept, placeholder, granted set, remote reference) of a docx/html export containing an out-of-directory image or a plantuml fence. This change closes that verification gap: artifact-level e2e pins for the embed-consent gate (html + docx branches: card raised with the deduplicated resolved list, Confirm embeds exactly the granted set, Cancel keeps the declined src with honest skipped accounting) and for the PlantUML-consent gate (html + docx branches: card names https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml and the per-diagram count, Confirm yields the remote reference only, Cancel yields the pinned source placeholder with no plantuml.com URL in the artifact), plus hold-green assertions that the m031 diff fence stays the only path into the .before read. No production code changes: every gate is frozen by its existing unit matrix. Red-first accounting is stated honestly per criterion — the behavior reds belong to the archived predecessor's evidence; this change's reds are coverage reds, and any new pin found red on the current tree at implementation time is by definition a regression, stopping the change for re-scope instead of being adapted.

Problem.Description: The wave-5 brief describes the pre-fix tree (the 2026-11-21 re-audit of commit 229b3a69). On this base all three findings verify as closed by .grace/changes/archive/C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES (graceVersion 4.0, status="applied"), read directly from the current tree: (1) embed scope consent — src/renderer/src/util/exportImages.js pins the pure classifier isInDocumentScope (START_BLOCK_SCOPE_GATE, :135-153, segment-boundary prefix match, Windows-only case folding) and embedLocalImages is the two-phase consent pass (:177-283): phase 1 classifies and deduplicates out-of-scope candidates (:188-215), the single awaited requestScopeConsent callback sits strictly before any out-of-scope I/O (:217-229, declined-by-default with no callback, BLOCK_EMBED_SCOPE_CONSENT/BLOCK_EMBED_SCOPE_DECLINED markers carry counts only :223/:271-274), declined references keep their src and count skipped; editor.vue wires the card into BOTH branches — styledHtml :2562-2564 and docx :2614-2616 — with the callback re-sourced from the C-EXPORT-DOCUMENT-PIN export pin, never a live currentFile read; (2) PlantUML export consent — src/muya/lib/utils/exportHtml.js exports countPlantUMLFences (:112-139) and the pinned declined shape plantUMLSourcePlaceholder (:144-146), generate() reads the opaque per-call options key plantumlRemoteConsent (absent = declined, :374-377), and renderDiagram's plantuml branch inserts the remote plantuml.com img only on consent, otherwise the placeholder (:249-262; the remote transport in src/muya/lib/parser/render/plantuml.js PLANTUML_URL :4, src build :54 is untouched by design); editor.vue raises the 'export-plantuml-consent' card (dedupKey :2376, requestPlantUMLExportConsent :2365) in the styledHtml (:2539-2541) and docx (:2599-2601) branches before exportStyledHTML carries the key; pdf/print run neither gate by pinned decision (corner C-12, editor.vue :2668-2672/:2707-2710) and their plantumlRemoteConsent stays absent = declined; (3) diff sidecar fence — src-tauri/src/m031_diff.rs mt_diff_baseline takes the Tauri-injected SecurityCtx (:54-58) and mt_diff_baseline_inner fences the '{path}.before' read with m010_security::check_path reused as-is (:74-80), a regular-file gate (:83-91) and the reused m013b::fs::MAX_READ_BYTES cap (:94-100) before the strict UTF-8 read (:104-105), denials as MT_FS_PATH_DENIED/MT_FS_NOT_REGULAR/MT_FS_TOO_LARGE with BLOCK_BASELINE_FAILED reason=sandbox_violation|not_regular_file|oversize, pinned by the in-file sandbox fixtures (:247-333). Unit-level coverage is likewise landed: tests/renderer/util/exportImages.test.js consent describe :307-443 (refusal, granted subset, dedupe, decline accounting), tests/renderer/components/editor-export-images.test.js consent wiring :446-741 (card shape :693, count-only privacy :717) plus the ten-locale completeness pins :743-805, tests/renderer/util/export-plantuml-gate.test.js for the pure helpers. The OPEN gap is the end-to-end layer. tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts pins the embed pass only through a consent-free document: the fixture lives entirely inside the document directory (/tmp/html-flow/flow.md with img/shot.png, :25-32, :44-60), so the consent card can never fire, and the artifact assertions (:86-96) never see an out-of-scope reference. tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts pins the docx write shape (save dialog → mt_fs_write_binary with ZIP magic, :47-101) with a document containing no images and no diagrams (:25-40); the written word/document.xml is asserted for text only (:181-189). The embed card is mounted by no e2e file; the PlantUML card is mounted in exactly one place — tests/e2e/export-document-pin.spec.ts, whose startHtmlExport mount assertion (:64-67) and confirmPlantUML action click (:69-71) drive a ```plantuml document's card purely to prove the pin's identity/disk refusals (:73-127) and the consented-document identity (:129-160), never the consent form; and no saved artifact is ever asserted to contain a declined out-of-scope src or the pre.ag-plantuml-export-source placeholder, while no artifact double proves the consented shapes (granted-subset embedding; exactly-one plantuml.com reference). The renderer failure surface of the diff fence is pinned only as the generic C-68 calm notice (tests/e2e/diff-view.spec.ts :132-160, baseline mocked at the shim); the backend fence pins live in the rust module alone. In short: the boundaries hold in unit tests, but the exported-artifact truth — what actually lands in the user's .html/.docx when a document reaches past its directory or names a remote diagram service — is verified nowhere above the unit layer, which is exactly the layer the export boundary is about.

Goals.R-1: (a) EMBED-CONSENT ARTIFACT PINS, html + docx: e2e tests drive a document whose images reach outside the document's directory through the real renderer to the saved-artifact double, both export doors. HTML door (extends tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts): a document referencing an in-directory sibling image AND an out-of-directory absolute image (stat/read mocks answer only the exact outside path, the established shim pattern :44-60) — on entering File › Export › HTML the 'export-embed-consent' card mounts (sticky dedupKey singleton) listing the deduplicated resolved outside path(s), their count and the document directory, and NO write happens while it is up; Confirm resolves the card and the artifact captured at the mt_fs_write double embeds the in-scope sibling and the granted outside file exactly as data URLs (byte-identical through the bridge), with the mt_fs_stat/mt_fs_read_binary invoke log touching only the granted out-of-scope paths plus the in-scope sibling; Cancel grants none — the outside img keeps its original src verbatim in the saved HTML, no data URL for it exists anywhere in the artifact, the in-scope sibling still embeds, and the embedded/total notice (editor.export.imagesEmbeddedTitle / imagesEmbeddedMessage, editor.vue :2571-2577) reports the exact {embedded}/{total} pair with the declined references counted as skipped — counts only, per the V-M-065 privacy convention. DOCX door (extends tests/e2e/export-office.spec.ts): the same two-image document through File › Export to Word — card raises before the save dialog resolves into conversion; Confirm → the written ZIP's media parts carry the granted images (JSZip, the tab-menu test's unpacking pattern), byte-identity pinned only as far as docx/html verifiably preserves it — any converter re-encode is pinned from observed output, never assumed; Cancel → the outside file's bytes appear nowhere in the ZIP, the in-scope sibling still lands, the embedded/total notice (editor.vue :2622-2628) reports the honest {embedded}/{total} pair, and the save/write invoke order stays the pinned one (plugin:dialog|save → mt_fs_write_binary). The card interaction rides the real notification stack — the mount/confirm mechanics already exist end to end in export-document-pin.spec.ts (:64-71, .notification-card text selector plus action button) and are reused, not reinvented; the export pin is exercised in its happy path (one stable document per test).
Goals.R-2: (b) PLANTUML-CONSENT ARTIFACT PINS, html + docx: e2e tests drive a document with exactly one ```plantuml fence through both doors. HTML door: the 'export-plantuml-consent' card mounts naming https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml and the per-diagram count before any exportStyledHTML render; Confirm → the saved HTML carries exactly one plantuml.com reference (the img src of the consented diagram) and no literal-source placeholder block; Cancel → the saved HTML carries the pinned declined shape — exactly one pre.ag-plantuml-export-source holding the escaped literal diagram source — and the string plantuml.com appears NOWHERE in the artifact; a zero-fence document raises no card at all (count 0 skips the dialog and passes false — the existing unit pin, now also proven through the real flow). DOCX door: the same document through Export to Word — the card raises with the same disclosure before conversion; Cancel → word/document.xml contains the literal source text and no plantuml.com string; for Confirm the docx-door e2e pins only the card plus a valid ZIP — the substantive consented assertion (the muya HTML handed to the converter carries the consented remote img; the decision handoff) stays at the unit layer, where tests/renderer/components/editor-export-images.test.js :562-643 pins the decision handoff only (exportStyledHTML mocked there; expect.objectContaining({ plantumlRemoteConsent: true })) — no test today executes the render branch itself (exportHtml.js insertImgElement under plantumlRemoteConsent === true), so the consented muya HTML form is proven by the new html-door e2e of this change, not by the existing unit pin — the converter is offline by construction and no e2e may depend on plantuml.com being reachable.
Goals.R-3: (c) DIFF FENCE HOLD-GREEN: no production change. The m031 fence stays the only path into the .before sidecar read, asserted by keeping the backend sandbox matrix green (baseline_sidecar_outside_sandbox_denied with no bytes returned, inward symlink reads, not-regular denial, over-cap denial, invalid-UTF-8 F7 preservation — m031_diff.rs :247-333) and the renderer failure surface green (diff-view.spec.ts baseline-failure fallback and calm-notice pins, :132-160); V-M-031 already carries these fence pins, so hold-green keeps them green with no verification delta for (c).
Goals.R-4: Governance: verification deltas land in the same bundle as the e2e pins — .grace/verification/features.xml strictly on V-M-065 (the artifact-level consent scenarios and their playwright command) and V-M-066 (the docx-door consent scenarios); .grace/graph/features.xml M-065/M-066 only if the plan records a contract-visible addition, otherwise untouched (the gates' contracts are already stated there, M-066 Dependencies line :3022 carries the post-consent-consumer note); no runtime.xml edits (muya M-012 and editor M-011 surfaces are read-only here); no new IPC command, no settings UI, no remembered consent, no release actions; grace lint runs only in the external target/final phases.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Any production code change: the three boundaries are delivered and frozen; no gate logic, copy, marker, i18n key, IPC command or backend fence is modified by this change.
The live-preview remote PlantUML fetch (muya/lib/parser/render/index.js:396) — the archived predecessor's recorded follow-up with its own approval; editor-preview behavior, not an export boundary.

The mt_share_file boundary (src-tauri/src/m032_share.rs takes the renderer-supplied path into the macOS share sheet with no SecurityCtx check) — a real unfenced command observed during the walk, but a share surface, not the docx/html export boundary this change verifies; recorded for the orchestrator as a candidate separate audit item, not absorbed.

Pdf/print gating: corner C-12 stands (their containers resolve src at print time; plantumlRemoteConsent stays absent = declined). Widening the gates to pdf/print is a behavior change outside this verification change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: (a) failing-first as a coverage red: on the pre-change tree no e2e test drives an out-of-directory image through either export door and none asserts any consent-formed artifact — the PlantUML card's single e2e mount (export-document-pin.spec.ts :64-70) serves the pin-refusal and identity scenarios, not artifact form (the gap above is the red evidence; the behavior reds are recorded in the archived predecessor's T-001 evidence); after the change, the html door pins card → Confirm embeds exactly the granted set (in-scope sibling + granted outside file as byte-identical data URLs, invoke log touching only granted paths) and card → Cancel keeps the declined src verbatim with the in-scope sibling still embedded and the skipped notice honest, and the docx door pins the same two outcomes at the ZIP double (granted media parts present exactly; declined outside bytes nowhere in the archive, in-scope sibling present, save→write order intact). Any of these pins red on the current tree at implementation time stops the change as a regression discovery.

(b) failing-first as a coverage red, same accounting: after the change the html door pins card disclosure (exactly https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml + the per-diagram count) before render, Confirm → exactly one plantuml.com reference and no placeholder block, Cancel → exactly one pre.ag-plantuml-export-source with the escaped literal source and zero plantuml.com strings in the artifact, zero fences → no card; the docx door pins the card disclosure, Cancel → literal source text and no plantuml.com string in word/document.xml, and the consented-docx assertion at the plan-pinned converter seam; no test depends on network reachability. Red on the current tree as a coverage red (the pins do not exist); green after; regression-stop rule identical to (a).

(c) hold-green: the m031 sandbox matrix (outside-sandbox denial returning no bytes, inward symlink read, not-regular, over-cap, invalid-UTF-8) and the diff-view baseline-failure/calm-notice e2e pins pass unchanged; no raw unfenced read enters m031_diff.rs; V-M-031 already carries the fence pins — hold-green keeps them green, no delta.

Existing pins stay green unweakened: the export-html-images in-scope artifact pins, the export-office modal-less/cancelled-dialog/tab-menu pins, the corner C-12 unit pins, the exportImages consent unit matrix (:307-443), the editor consent-wiring and ten-locale pins (:446-805), the plantuml-gate pure pins, the export-document-pin store/component pins and the diff renderer suites all pass without weakened assertions or budget changes.
